title: The One Direction Quiz
subtitle: Three rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by claude-sonnet-5 for "One Direction". NOT YET REVIEWED — read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Which TV talent show did One Direction form on in 2010?
questions.answerNote: The five were put together as a group after failing to make it as soloists on The X Factor in 2010.

questions.prompt: Which member left One Direction in March 2015?
questions.answerNote: Zayn Malik departed to pursue a solo career, leaving the band as a four-piece.

questions.prompt: What was One Direction's debut single, released in 2011?
questions.answerNote: "What Makes You Beautiful" gave the band their first UK number one single.

questions.prompt: Which English town is Louis Tomlinson from?
questions.answerNote: Louis Tomlinson grew up in Doncaster, South Yorkshire.

questions.prompt: What was the title of One Direction's debut studio album?
questions.answerNote: Up All Night was released in November 2011.

questions.prompt: Which album gave One Direction their first UK number one on the Albums Chart?
questions.answerNote: Take Me Home topped the UK Albums Chart in November 2012, unlike their debut which peaked at number two.

questions.prompt: Which Harry Styles solo single reached number one in the UK in 2017?
questions.answerNote: "Sign of the Times" was Harry Styles' debut solo single and it topped the UK chart.

questions.prompt: Niall Horan grew up in which country?
questions.answerNote: Niall Horan is from Mullingar, County Westmeath, in Ireland.

questions.prompt: The song "Story of My Life" appears on which One Direction album?
questions.answerNote: Midnight Memories was released in 2013 and included "Story of My Life".

questions.prompt: Liam Payne grew up in which English city?
questions.answerNote: Liam Payne was born and raised in Wolverhampton.
